manifest top-level keys == heroine hsc19 manifest
character is member-only ji-cheng (no appearance key)
index has exactly the ji-cheng key, no hero key, names the manifest
eight canonical actions: required with loop flags + skill; no victory
contract fields == heroine (cell, pivot, facing, scale, proportion)
cell and pivot even (logical scale 0.5)
every action duration == heroine (ticks)
tick schema: every action tick_rate 30, frames use ticks only, loop_start only on loops
strike cue (lens flare) on attack frame 0 = tick 0; no other attack frame has a flare
strike: open magnifier extended ahead (lens >= pelvis + 30 px) and the flare lance reaches x >= 128
attack recovers: magnifier folds after the follow-through and reopens by recover
guard raises the closed book cover-out upright in front of the face (far hand above the shoulder)
skill = Fault-Line Recall (book open, magnifier lens over the page, fault trace, recall brackets as the book closes)
defeat ends kneeling with eyes shut, magnifier folded and the book down
sheet is a cell multiple, 6 columns, each cell == its pose PNG; package copy == outputs copy
